claims: Carnegie Mellon University is located in Pittsburgh, PA.
Carnegie Mellon University is a private research university.
Carnegie Mellon University is ranked #20 in the 2026 U.S. News & World Report National Universities list.
Carnegie Mellon University has an overall acceptance rate of approximately 11.66% as of 2024.
The School of Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon University has a reported 3% acceptance rate.
Admitted students to Carnegie Mellon University typically have GPAs in the 3.7 to 4.0 range.
Admitted students to Carnegie Mellon University have average Evidence-Based Reading and Writing test scores of 730-770.
Admitted students to Carnegie Mellon University have average Math test scores of 770-800.
Tuition at Carnegie Mellon University for the 2023-2024 academic year was $63,829.
Colleges at Carnegie Mellon University include the School of Computer Science.
Colleges at Carnegie Mellon University include the College of Engineering.
Colleges at Carnegie Mellon University include the College of Fine Arts.
Faculty and alumni of Carnegie Mellon University have received Nobel Prizes.
Institutions often referred to as "CMU" include Central Michigan University.
